title: the-route-sieves-carve-out-of-inference-domain
intention: MOVE THE ROUTE SIEVE MESH OUT OF THE COMPONENT THAT DIALS THE HOST, so it can join the proof record like every other gate in the sweep. cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/route.py holds a six-sieve mesh (enabled, never_routed, serves_kind, keyed, addressed, the_nest) plus domain_rows/_finding, and route() returns {"survivors", "gradation", "findings"} with RouteRefused carrying .findings. That findings list is the exact shape the ruling retires: it is empty when every sieve passed AND when a sieve stopped running, so the refusal gate is a gate on SILENCE. The fix is the same one already applied twice in-house: THE SEAM STAYS IN THE DEVICE, THE GATE BERTHS AS A HELD MACHINE — cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route/ — and then the mesh converts to inspect_* returning the proof record, with the findings list surviving as a VIEW over the record's mismatches (derived, never parallel).
why: THIS IS THE ONE PLACE IN THE SWEEP WHERE DOING THE RIGHT THING IN PLACE WOULD MANUFACTURE A VIOLATION. Every other conversion this crossing was `import cairn.tools.gate` plus lanes. Here that single import turns the whole device into a gate that reaches an oracle, because bin/cmd/determinism computes is_gate and llm-reach at COMPONENT granularity and inference_domain's fire path already reaches the LLM. The lived symptom if it is left as it is: Akien opens `cairn determinism` during the sprint he named — "akien can inspect the gates and inspectors and find them deterministic and mostly deterministic respectively, I want to SEE that" — and the sole path to the inference host is the one component whose routing decisions cannot say what they proved. When a request routes to the wrong model, the record says which sieve OBJECTED and never which sieves RAN, so a sieve that quietly stopped firing looks exactly like a request that passed clean.
traces_to: Law 3 — nothing is known until measured. "The route mesh found nothing wrong" is today an inference from an empty list, not a measurement of six sieves.

Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics. The no-oracle rule IS physics here (bin/cmd/determinism, gate_violation at determinism.py:309); this ticket is the debt that physics exposed rather than a policy anyone has to remember.
Law 7 — errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces. RouteRefused's .findings is a diagnostic surface and delivers half a diagnosis: the objections, never the attendance.
Law 9 — red is the default. A sieve that stopped running currently reads green.
Ruling 2026-08-13 everything-always-proved-and-listing-what-it-proved — "SAME PATTERN EVERYWHERE". This is the named remainder of everywhere.
Ruling 2026-08-13 every-machine-carries-its-own-inspector-and-gate — the route mesh is precisely a machine that should carry its own.

falsifier.proves_green: The carve-out is done when `./bin/cmd/determinism` lists a NEW row — cairn/devices/inference_domain/machines/route — as a PURE DETERMINISTIC GATE, while cairn/devices/inference_domain itself still reads REFUSES with NO gate and therefore no gate_violation; and `./bin/cmd/test -q` stays all-green with the route proofs moved beside the machine. The device keeps the seam (domain.py, host.py) and holds the machine; nothing about the dial changes.
falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: (1) route.py gaining `from cairn.tools.gate import gate` at its CURRENT address — that is the violation this ticket exists to avoid, and bin/cmd/determinism will say so; (2) any lane whose `expected` and `actual` cannot be `==` when it passes — the authoring hazard measured n=4 on 2026-08-13, which reds every HEALTHY subject; the offending value rides in `values`; (3) the findings list surviving as a SECOND implementation rather than a view over the record's mismatches — two mouths for one question is how a gate and the sentence it prints come to disagree; (4) a sieve that did not run appearing in the record as a passing lane rather than being ABSENT — guarded lanes append only when their input is present; (5) the machine's proof roster being HAND-TYPED — a tooth nobody listed is a tooth that did not run, and the file prints the same green line (caught twice on 2026-08-13); (6) the new machine's import surface reaching anything beyond the gate tool and the sieve mesh's own pure dependencies — measure it with an AST tooth like cairn/devices/intention_extractor/machines/judge/proofs/test_judge.py::test_the_judge_holds_no_seam_of_its_own, do not assert it in prose.
falsifier.horizon: Do it when the sweep's remaining targets are done or when someone is next inside route.py for another reason. It is NOT urgent-in-anger: the mesh is small, stable, and its sieves currently all fire. It IS the last known component blocking the ruling's "everywhere" from being true.

how: Move the route sieve mesh out of cairn/devices/inference_domain/ into a standalone position where it can join the proof record like every other gate in the sweep.
